summary: This Form 6-K reports the result of a shareholder general meeting for AngloGold Ashanti plc. The only resolution was authority to purchase own shares off-market, which passed with 66.08% for and 33.92% against. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing reflects a routine capital management resolution, not a special situation like an issuer tender offer or going-private transaction. There is no forced management change, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The outcome is procedural and ordinary.
